disorder-name.detail: Autism spectrum disorder; clinical diagnoses based on DSM-IV, DSM-IV-TR, DSM-5, or ICD-10 criteria. Primary cohort from EU-AIMS LEAP (N=352) and replication cohort from ABIDE I+II (N=513).
disorder-name.supporting_text: "All participants with autism spectrum disorder had an existing clinical diagnosis of autism."; "All participants with autism had an existing clinical diagnosis of autism according to DSM-IV, DSM-IV-TR, DSM-5 or ICD-10 criteria."
disorder-name.location: Floris2021.pdf.md: Methods / Participants, L41; Floris2021_sup.pdf.md: Participants, study design and exclusion criteria, L7

dataset-of-origin.detail: Primary analysis used the EU-AIMS LEAP dataset (352 ASD); replication analysis used the combined ABIDE I and II dataset (513 ASD). Sites using the same scanner across ABIDE I and II were merged, resulting in 15 sites total.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Participants were part of the EU-AIMS and AIMS-2-TRIALS LEAP cohort"; "we selected a sample from the publicly available Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) I and II"
dataset-of-origin.location: Floris2021.pdf.md: Methods / Participants, L41; Floris2021_sup.pdf.md: Replication sample ABIDE I and II, L103-L105

answer.note: weighted mean / pooled SD across LEAP and ABIDE subgroups

age.detail: Computed as weighted mean and pooled SD across four sex-by-dataset subgroups: LEAP ASD males (n=259, mean=16.8, SD=5.4), LEAP ASD females (n=93, mean=16.9, SD=6.1), ABIDE ASD males (n=418, mean=12.8, SD=4.1), ABIDE ASD females (n=95, mean=12.6, SD=4.3). Total N=865. Age range 6-30 years for both cohorts.
